sources.name: Hong Kong — CSB civil-service and non-civil-service vacancies
sources.authority: Civil Service Bureau, Hong Kong SAR
sources.notes: Official board distinguishes civil-service and non-civil-service appointments. General civil-service appointment rules require Hong Kong permanent residence, with Basic Law exceptions; this is not a citizenship whitelist or an examination-registration rule. Language criteria differ by grade and are not universal CEFR thresholds.
sources.accessGap: No adapter or reviewed cycle. Individual vacancy terms, exceptions, international applicant residence evidence, qualifications, employment arrangement, application windows and official timezones require review. Civil-service appointment rules cannot automatically classify non-civil-service jobs. Board job links use JavaScript and need verified detail routes. Other authorities and all four pathways remain incompletely inventoried.

sources.name: Hong Kong — Common Recruitment Examination and BLNST
sources.authority: Civil Service Bureau, Civil Service Examinations Unit, Hong Kong SAR
sources.notes: Current official PDF identifies 5 December 2026 examination outside Hong Kong and 2 October 2026 23:59 Hong Kong time filing deadline. Degree holders, specified future graduates and professional qualification routes differ. CRE English/Chinese levels are native test results; accepted Academic IELTS equivalence is official and pathway-specific. Exam registration does not establish eligibility for civil-service appointment.
sources.accessGap: No adapter or reviewed cycle. Foreign-applicant permission, qualification exceptions, exact registration opening, BLNST and grade-specific requirements need review. Seven published exam cities form one application call; street venues are unassigned and must not become fabricated pins. October Hong Kong and December outside-Hong-Kong editions must remain distinct. Original-language applicant notes retained. This exam source does not cover all recruitment, licensing, admissions or vocational pathways.

sources.name: Qatar — CGB Kawader government jobseeker registration
sources.authority: Civil Service and Government Development Bureau, Qatar
sources.notes: Official Sharek service restricts this registration route to Qataris or children of Qatari mothers, ages 18–60, with valid documents and foreign-qualification equivalence where needed. A citizenship-only whitelist would lose the parentage route. Jobseeker registration is distinct from an advertised job application or appointment.
sources.accessGap: No adapter or verified application cycle. Full registration exclusions, parentage and identity evidence, exact vacancy conditions, employment arrangement, qualification equivalence and language thresholds require review. Service description does not establish current open vacancies or all public-employer hiring routes. Other authorities and pathways remain incompletely inventoried.
